استنطقا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْطَقَا (istanṭaqā) /is.tan.tˤa.qaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# اُسْتُنْطِقَا (ustunṭiqā) /us.tun.tˤi.qaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# اِسْتَنْطِقَا (istanṭiqā) /is.tan.tˤi.qaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
